 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose
 Show Most recent Most popular FULL-TIME published at 19:39 BST 19:39 BST 
 Como 4-1 Manchester United 
 A brilliant and memorable night for Como as they deservedly beat Manchester United.
 A desperate defeat for Michael Carrick's side.
 605 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:37 BST 19:37 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Lovely place to get sacked. Could stay and make a long weekend of it.
 Gator, London 
 2019 125 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Too little too late I'm afraid' published at 19:37 BST 19:37 BST 
 Como 4-1 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 It was a lovely first touch I must say. [Zirkzee] just stays onside, and it's a beautiful first touch and finish.
 Too little too late I'm afraid.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 387 145 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:36 BST 19:36 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Speak to Middlesbrough fans about their form in the second half of the season when Carrick was manager and you'll have an idea of why Utd are where they are (since this is technically his second half of the season with them).
 John, Liverpool 
 751 182 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:36 BST 19:36 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 No, it does stand.
 No clean sheet for Como but they won't really care. This will still be seen a memorable and historic win for them.
 451 589 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee - potential offside published at 19:35 BST 19:35 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Actually, it might not stand.
 774 221 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Como 4-1 Manchester United published at 19:34 BST 19:34 BST 
 Joshua Zirkzee 
 Manchester United get a goal back in stoppage time.
 It is nice control and finish by Joshua Zirkzee but unsurprisingly there are no celebrations from the visitors.
 Image source, Reuters 
 586 1562 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Disjointed' published at 19:33 BST 19:33 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This looks like a plan - they're not going to press high, they're not going to try and engage in the same way that we see with lots of other really good teams, for example Como today. It looks awful and I think disjointed is a good way to describe it. 
 580 77 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:32 BST 19:32 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 This is arguably Manchester United's worst performance and result of the season as their poor run of form continues. Do you think Michael Carrick survives this? 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 870 2434 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:29 BST 19:29 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Five minutes to go and Manchester United make another change as Shea Lacey comes on for Bryan Mbeumo.
 334 204 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Paz has been 'absolutely brilliant' published at 19:29 BST 19:29 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 Everyone is standing up in the stands and rightly so. 
 [Paz] been absolutely brilliant in everything that he has done today. I don't think he's done anything wrong, and a lot of his play has been creative and risky, but he's pulled it off.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 727 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:28 BST 19:28 BST 
 Bayern Munich v Arsenal (20:00 BST) 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter at the Allianz Arena 
 Both sides are out warming up on the pitch as it gets closer to kick-off and the rain is really coming down. It really is an impressive place to watch football. 
 Two big teams in the league phase, it should turn out to be a great watch. 
 260 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:26 BST 19:26 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Carrick must walk & he should walk tonight.
 David, Leeds 
 At this point, it's hard to think we'd have been any worse off had we kept Amorim.
 James, Cambridgeshire 
 2220 484 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:26 BST 19:26 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 No surprises but it looks like many of the travelling Manchester United fans have had enough as the away end is looking pretty empty now. 
 1133 100 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:25 BST 19:25 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Changes for both sides. Harry Amass is on for Matthijs de Ligt for Manchester United while Samuele Ricci and Alberto Dossena are on for Máximo Perrone and Nico Paz, who gets a standing ovation after his two goals.
 391 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'What a wonderful, wonderful goal' published at 19:24 BST 19:24 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 What a wonderful wonderful goal and it sums up their performance from the first minute to now, and it's the centre back who pops up as a centre forward!
 Image source, Reuters 
 1104 108 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:23 BST 19:23 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United are four goals down in a Champions League match for the first time since November 1994, when they were beaten 4-0 by Barcelona.
 1548 165 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:22 BST 19:22 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Absolutely disgraceful. Worse team I've seen from Man Utd and I've been a fan since 1987. Woeful.
 Matt, Northwich 
 3260 263 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 19:22 BST 19:22 BST 
 Como 4-0 Manchester United 
 Are Como done? No chance as Senne Lammens has to stretch to prevent Nico Paz smashing in his third goal.
 704 64 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'They have no fear in there' published at 19:21 BST 19:21 BST 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 Como have been absolutely brilliant. They have no fear in there, they are prepared to give [the pass] to a player that's marked.
 They have runners off the ball as well, and they always seen to have a spare man in possession, and that's a sign of a very well drilled side.
